source_text: Οἱ δὲ τοῦ θεοῦ ἄνθρωποι, πνευματοφόροι πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ προφῆται γενόμενοι, ὑπ᾿ αὐτοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐμπνευσθέντες καὶ σοφισθέντες, ἐγένοντο θεοδίδακτοι καὶ ὅσιοι καὶ δίκαιοι. Διὸ καὶ κατηξιώθησαν τὴν ἀντιμισθίαν ταύτην λαβεῖν, ὄργανα θεοῦ γενόμενοι καὶ χωρήσαντες σοφίαν τὴν παρ᾿ αὐτοῦ, δι᾿ ἧς σοφίας εἶπον καὶ τὰ περὶ τῆς κτίσεως τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν ἁπάντων. Καὶ γὰρ περὶ λοιμῶν καὶ λιμῶν καὶ πολέμων προεῖπον. Καὶ οὐχ εἷς ἢ δύο ἀλλὰ πλείονες κατὰ χρόνους καὶ καιροὺς ἐγενήθησαν παρὰ Ἑβραίοις, ἀλλὰ καὶ παρὰ Ἕλλησιν Σίβυλλα· καὶ πάντες φίλα ἀλλήλοις καὶ σύμφωνα εἰρήκασιν, τά τε πρὸ αὐτῶν γεγενημένα καὶ τὰ κατ᾿ αὐτοὺς γεγονότα καὶ τὰ καθ᾿ ἡμᾶς νυνὶ τελειούμενα· διὸ καὶ πεπείσμεθα καὶ περὶ τῶν μελλόντων οὕτως ἔσεσθαι, καθὼς καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἀπήρτισται.
pass_a_gloss: The people of God, being bearers of the Holy Spirit and having become prophets, were inspired and made wise by God Himself, and they became taught by God and holy and righteous. Therefore, they were deemed worthy to receive this reward, having become instruments of God and having received wisdom from Him, through which wisdom they spoke about the creation of the world and all other things. They also foretold about plagues and famines and wars. And not just one or two, but many were born at different times and seasons, not only among the Hebrews but also among the Greeks, a Sibyl; and all have spoken friendly and harmonious things, both about the things that happened before them and the things that happened during their time and the things that are now being fulfilled among us. Therefore, we are also convinced that the things to come will be so, just as the first things were fulfilled.

choices.english: just as the first things were fulfilled
rejected: just as the first things were completed

pass_b_english: God's people, as bearers of the Holy Spirit and having become prophets, were inspired and made wise by God Himself, and so became God-taught, holy, and righteous. For this reason they were deemed worthy to receive this reward, having become instruments of God and having received wisdom from Him; through that wisdom they spoke about the creation of the world and everything else. They also foretold plagues, famines, and wars. Not merely one or two, but many were raised up at various times and seasons—not only among the Hebrews but also among the Greeks, a Sibyl—and all have spoken in friendly accord with one another, covering both the events before them, those in their own day, and those now being fulfilled among us. Therefore we too are convinced that the things to come will be so, just as the first things were fulfilled.

review.notes: All clauses in the Greek source [p1] are accurately represented in both Pass A and Pass B. The translation of 'ἀπήρτισται' as 'fulfilled' is acceptable in this context. The distinction between Hebrews and Greeks (Sibyl) is preserved. No omissions or contradictions found.
